about: Public-opinion polls on each ask, from the pollster's own page. Questions are paraphrased; fielded is the month fieldwork began; fit_note says where a poll only partly matches the ask. Figures were checked against the source page on the date above. An ask with no credible poll is left out.

not_found.ask-ai-fossil-fuels: No poll found on AI used by or sold to oil and gas companies.

polls.pollster: AP-NORC and the Energy Policy Institute at the University of Chicago
polls.question: How concerned are people about data centers' effect on the local water supply?
polls.result: 79% say they are concerned about data centers' effect on the water supply

polls.pollster: Yale Program on Climate Change Communication
polls.question: Would people support or oppose building a data center in their local area?
polls.result: 56% oppose a local data center; 15% support one
polls.fit_note: Measures local opposition, not rights or community consent specifically.

polls.pollster: Heatmap Pro, conducted by Embold Research
polls.question: Would voters support or oppose a data center planned for their area?
polls.result: More than 70% say they would oppose one
polls.fit_note: Measures local opposition, not rights or community consent specifically.

polls.question: Are data centers mostly good or mostly bad for home energy costs?
polls.result: 50% say mostly bad for home energy costs, up from 38% in January 2026

polls.pollster: AP-NORC and the Energy Policy Institute at the University of Chicago
polls.question: How concerned are people about data centers' effect on local electricity prices?
polls.result: 84% say they are concerned about the effect on local electricity prices

polls.pollster: Morning Consult, for Americans for Responsible Innovation
polls.question: Should children under 16 be barred from AI chatbots built to form romantic or erotic relationships?

polls.population: US parents of teens ages 13 to 17
polls.question: Would parents be comfortable with their teen getting emotional support or advice from an AI chatbot?
polls.result: Only 18% of parents say they would be comfortable

polls.question: How comfortable are people with companies using their online behavior to personalize ads?
polls.fit_note: Asks about personalized ads generally, not AI specifically.

polls.question: Do people support or oppose the military using AI to select military targets?
polls.fit_note: Asks about military use of AI, not about vendors checking their customers.

polls.pollster: Gallup, with the Special Competitive Studies Project
polls.question: Do people support or oppose the US developing AI-enabled autonomous weapons for military conflicts?
polls.result: 48% oppose; 39% support. If other nations build them first, 53% support
polls.fit_note: Asks about military use of AI, not about vendors checking their customers.

polls.question: How concerned are people about AI spreading misleading video and audio deepfakes?
polls.result: 63% are very concerned, up from 58% in March 2025

polls.question: How concerned are people that groups trying to sway the 2024 election would use AI to spread false information?
polls.result: 57% are extremely or very concerned, with similar shares of Republicans and Democrats

polls.question: How concerned are people about bias in decisions made by AI?
Should AI companies be allowed to train their models on the open internet, which includes large amounts of copyrighted material?
polls.result: 44% say they should not; 20% say they should

polls.question: Will AI reduce the number of US jobs over the next 10 years?
polls.result: 79% say it will, up from 73% in 2025

polls.question: How concerned are workers that AI may make their own job obsolete?
polls.result: 30% are very or somewhat concerned, up from 21% in April 2025

polls.question: Should companies developing AI have to meet independent safety standards, even if that slows development?
Are businesses doing enough to be open about how they use AI?
polls.result: 76% say businesses are not doing enough
